description: This file defines the YamlTranslationLoader class, which extends Symfony's YamlFileLoader to load translation catalogues from YAML files with caching support in the Goteo application.

classes.name: YamlTranslationLoader
classes.description: A custom loader extending Symfony's YamlFileLoader to add caching capabilities for translation files in the Goteo application.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a translation catalogue from a YAML resource, utilizing cache if available, and serializes/unserializes the catalogue for performance optimization.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the loader supports the given resource based on its file extension (yml).
